episodes.title: How Did A Spanish Court Really Call Jehovah's Witnesses A “DESTRUCTIVE CULT”: Is This The Collapse?
episodes.description:
Did a Spanish court really declare Jehovah’s Witnesses a “destructive cult”?

The answer is more complicated than the headline suggests.

In 2023, Jehovah’s Witnesses in Spain took the Spanish Association of Victims of Jehovah’s Witnesses to court over statements describing the organization as a “destructive sect” and referring to former members as “victims.”

The case eventually reached the Madrid Provincial Court in 2026.

But what did the courts actually decide?
